size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in one file, the register controller, which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/register and the wrong status.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/register creates the account and returns the user and tokens, but the response status is 200 instead of 201 Created.

root_cause.detail: register responds with httpStatus.OK instead of httpStatus.CREATED.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/register > should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok'
